workflow: An operation collects elements from a caller-provided mapping into temporary sequences and begins converting one element through user-controlled conversion logic.
The conversion callback reentrantly mutates the source data, releasing the element while the operation retains only a borrowed reference.
The operation continues using or cleaning up the released element as though it were still valid.
The access reaches freed storage, causing a use-after-free crash instead of completing safely.
summary: Reentrant mutation releases a borrowed element before conversion completes
decision_reason: The failure is materially the same as retaining a pointer into storage whose owner releases the object before a later use; the reentrant callback is the trigger, while the core mechanism is use-after-free.
